title: Talent Acquisition Internship
full_description:
Internship, full or part-time, 5–6 months, Brussels, knowledge of English, Dutch/French a plusOnly for students currently enrolled in a Master’s degree
Your role & work environment
Join ourTalent Acquisition Teamand contribute to the recruitment journey at ING Belgium!We are responsible for internal and external hiring for the bank. As a Talent Acquisition Intern, you will support ourcampus recruitment strategyand participate inrecruitment events.  You will also independently manage ourinternship recruitment activities, giving you hands-on experience and real responsibility.
Your key responsibilities
You will be actively involved in our Campus Recruitment planning, events, and initiatives:
Support our Campus Recruitment Lead in rolling out a new campus recruitment approach
Build tools and reporting to follow up on campus events
Participate in recruitment events such as virtual career fairs, presentations, and campus activities
Take part in the full recruitment process and support the team with:
Opening new vacancies
Screening CVs and identifying potential candidates
Participating in competency-based interviews (STAR method)
Internship recruitment
You will beresponsiblefor managing the recruitment of ING interns:
Opening internship positions together with hiring managers
Conducting intakes with hiring managers
Publishing roles on platforms
Proactively searching for candidates
Screening CVs and conducting phone interviews
Preparing and creating internship contracts
A colleague who is proactive, motivated, and eager to learn. Someone who enjoys helping others, brings fresh ideas, and feels at home in a dynamic and fast-changing environment. You collaborate easily, challenge the status quo, and look for creative ways to improve processes.
As a Talent Acquisition Intern:
You are passionate about people
You listen actively and communicate clearly
You are resourceful and take initiative
You work autonomously and deliver on time and in quality
You are a strong team player
You speakEnglish,and have avery good knowledge of Dutch or Drench (a plus)
You are confident using Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)
You are enrolled in thefirst or second year of a Master’s degree
You are available for afull-time internship of 5 to 6 monthsas part of your studies
A clear purpose and valuable learning experience:
Personal growth and challenging work, with many opportunities to develop your skills
An informal and dynamic environment with supportive, innovative colleagues
A progressive and agile way of working where new ideas are encouraged
We redefine banking. What about you?There has never been a more exciting time to work at ING. We are on a journey centred around our customers, powered by technology, and driven by talented people. Our colleagues help customers stay a step ahead in life and in business — and we’re proud of that!
ING’s vision is to unlock our people’s full potential through our inclusive culture where everyone has the opportunity to develop and have impact for our customers and society. To achieve this vision, our policies support diversity, equity, and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind with regard to age, gender, gender identity, cultural background, experience, religion, race, ethnicity, disability, family responsibilities, sexual orientation, social origin, or any other status protected by applicable law. If you require any assistance or if we can accommodate you in any way when participating in our application and/or interview process, please email the recruiting contact listed for the relevant position. We will be happy to work with you to ensure a fair and accessible process. Read more about our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging here.
